Documenting a route never authorizes it. The charter and code win over a conflicting sheet. No direct provider-to-provider channel exists; route every exchange through the Director.

Platform limitations

  • limitation
    Cursor cannot use an implicit dashboard repository; every run needs an allowlisted project, repository, and starting ref, and model output or owner approval cannot widen those lists.
    source
    docs/provider-setup.html
  • limitation
    Auto-generated cursor/... working branches are not durable starting points; they are deleted after merge, and a follow-up starts a new agent from the durable ref.
    source
    docs/provider-setup.html
  • limitation
    Cursor Cloud Agents cannot see the Windows deployment environment; secrets needed by a cloud agent must be injected as Cursor Cloud secrets.
    source
    AGENTS.md, Cursor Cloud specific instructions
  • limitation
    Cursor is an unsupported Windows host-bridge lane by design; it stays a direct cloud API contact.
    source
    src/director_orchestrator/host_provider_bridge.py:UNSUPPORTED_HOST_LANES
  • limitation
    Owner-reported account context: lower-capacity paid service; API billing and quotas must be verified separately.
    source
    src/director_orchestrator/config.py:provider_strategy

Communication

relay_rule
provider_messages_relay_through_director
direct_provider_to_provider_channels_exist
false
notes
  • Cursor reaches Claude, Grok, OpenAI, and every other lane only through Director-authored packets, declared dependency outcomes, review handoffs, and moderated debate turns.
  • Cursor records logical producer and material contributor evidence through Director-managed records, not direct provider messaging.
  • Cursor never posts to the Slack thread; the Director relays a concise assignment-correlated summary.

This profile does not change

  • committee voting weights or the immutable denominator
  • runtime permissions or allowlists
  • provider credentials
  • deployments or service state
  • Slack behaviour
  • deterministic policy in src/director_orchestrator/policy.py
